name: Hao0321/claude-skill-social-post
type: Cross-platform Social Content Agent Skill / Closed-loop Content System
purpose: 讓 Codex、Claude Code 或精簡 ChatGPT Chat 流程依使用者真實貼文與成效學習聲線，規劃內容、撰寫平台化貼文，經人工確認後發布，並把 FB／IG／Threads／X 等平台的成效與互動 evidence 保存成可驗證的結構化資料，供下一輪內容決策使用。
recommendation: 適合想把社群內容從一次性 prompt 升級成持續學習系統：保留自己的 voice、內容規劃、平台化改寫、人工核准、發布、成效記錄與 pattern optimization，同時避免把私人貼文與帳號資料放進公開 repo。
notes: Official repository verified. The skill separates planning, voice learning, drafting/publishing, outcome logging, pattern optimization and comment operations. Private voice, real posts, account performance and comments remain local. Live browser actuation is capability-gated and unproven capability should fail closed.
